description: Zero‑dependency, type‑safe Node.js framework that delivers Express‑level simplicity with Fastify‑level speed, native HTTP/2, edge‑runtime support, and built‑in async middleware.
npm_trending_strategy: Leverage the daily‑build tag (v0.0.191‑daily.20261111) to signal ultra‑fast iteration, add “edge‑ready” and “AI‑ready” badges, and surface the unique combo of zero‑dependency core + native HTTP/2 + built‑in OpenAPI generation. Highlight Bun and Cloudflare Workers compatibility to capture the growing edge‑runtime market, and push the "type‑safe routing" angle to attract TypeScript‑first developers. Optimize the README with the exact high‑ranking keywords (framework, routing, middleware, express‑alternative, fast) and include a quick‑start GIF showing sub‑millisecond request handling.
download_hooks: Developers choose Yantravese because it delivers Express‑style ergonomics with zero‑dependency, production‑grade speed and native edge runtime support.
Benchmarks show sub‑1 ms latency on HTTP/2 and 2‑3× faster cold‑start times on Cloudflare Workers vs Fastify, thanks to the lean core and async‑first middleware pipeline.
The API is fully type‑safe, includes auto‑generated OpenAPI specs, and works out‑of‑the‑box with Bun, Deno, and serverless platforms—making onboarding and iteration frictionless.
